extraction_notes:
LANE: ClinicalTrials.gov posted results, adverse-event tables (public-domain US government data).

WHAT WAS ACTUALLY FETCHED THIS SESSION
- ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 search endpoint (/api/v2/studies?query.intr=<drug>&aggFilters=results:with) run over 32 oligonucleotide drug names.
- Full study records (/api/v2/studies/<NCT>) downloaded and parsed for 20 NCTs. Rows were extracted from 15 of them.
- DailyMed SPINRAZA (nusinersen) label, setid dd70cd5f-b0fc-4ba4-a5ea-89a34778bd94, section 11 DESCRIPTION.
- Local capture sources/cns/QALSODY_tofersen_label_dailymed.htm, section 11 DESCRIPTION.

HOW THE NUMBERS WERE PRODUCED (anti-fabrication control)
Every row was generated by a script that indexes into the downloaded JSON at the exact locus recorded in source_table,
ASSERTS that the event term at that index equals the term expected for the row, and only then computes numerator,
denominator and percentage. All 131 term assertions passed; no row carries a hand-transcribed number. readout_value is
the percentage computed as 100*numAffected/numAtRisk, and notes carries the raw n_of_N. effect_direction is
determined by comparing the treated and control percentages ROUNDED TO ONE DECIMAL PLACE, the same precision at which
readout_value is stored. This matters for exactly three rows (TMP_ct_m46, TMP_ct_m112, TMP_ct_m113) where the treated
and control arms have IDENTICAL numerators and denominators differing by under 1% (e.g. inclisiran back pain, 39/781 vs
39/778): these are recorded as no_change, which is the honest reading, rather than as a spurious increase or decrease
produced by fourth-decimal-place noise. All three are grade 0 either way. source_table records the exact
locus (e.g. resultsSection.adverseEventsModule.otherEvents[106]) plus the MedDRA term, organ system and arm title,
so any row can be re-verified against the API in one call.

NCTs WITH USABLE POSTED RESULTS (rows extracted)
  Intrathecal / CNS-delivered (is_cns_specific=TRUE):
    NCT02623699 tofersen VALOR, Parts A/B/C, intrathecal placebo control ............ 24 rows
    NCT03070119 tofersen open-label extension, up to 364 weeks, no control .......... 13 rows
    NCT03761849 tominersen GENERATION HD1, intrathecal placebo control .............. 19 rows
    NCT03342053 tominersen open-label extension, monthly vs bimonthly ............... 13 rows
    NCT02292537 nusinersen CHERISH, sham-procedure control ..........................  4 rows
    NCT02193074 nusinersen ENDEAR, sham-procedure control ...........................  2 rows
    NCT04089566 nusinersen DEVOTE, 50/28 mg vs approved 12 mg .......................  6 rows
    NCT02386553 nusinersen NURTURE, chronic dosing to Day 2891 ......................  4 rows
    NCT03225833 WVE-120101, 5 dose levels vs pooled intrathecal placebo ............. 12 rows
  Systemic comparators (is_cns_specific=FALSE):
    NCT01737398 inotersen NEURO-TTR .... 7    NCT01960348 patisiran APOLLO ....... 6
    NCT03399370 inclisiran ORION-10 .... 6    NCT04060199 viltolarsen RACER53 .... 4
    NCT02310906 golodirsen ............. 4    NCT00607373 mipomersen ............. 3
    NCT02211209 volanesorsen APPROACH .. 4

DRUGS SEARCHED THAT RETURNED NO POSTED RESULTS AT ALL
  fomivirsen, zilganersen, ION-859, jacifusen, ulefnersen, BIIB080 (MAPT ASO), AMT-130, milasen, drisapersen.
  These are the CNS-relevant misses that matter most: BIIB080 (intrathecal tau ASO), zilganersen (intrathecal GFAP ASO
  for Alexander disease) and jacifusen/ulefnersen (intrathecal FUS ASO) would all have been high-value CNS rows.
  Their trials have no posted results on ClinicalTrials.gov, so nothing was extracted rather than guessed.

DRUGS WITH POSTED RESULTS THAT WERE FETCHED BUT NOT MINED
  givosiran NCT03338816 and lumasiran NCT03681184 were downloaded but not extracted - the systemic negative-control
  comparator set was already well covered by seven other systemic drugs, and adding more would have inflated the row
  count without adding information. Also not mined: eteplirsen, casimersen, eplontersen NCT04136184 (fetched; its only
  CNS-coded serious events were single syncope/vertigo/cerebral-haemorrhage terms with no placebo arm - it is an
  open-label active-controlled study, so effect_vs_control would have been uninformative), pegaptanib (17 trials,
  intravitreal, out of CNS scope), defibrotide, apatorsen, custirsen, alicaforsen, nedosiran, olezarsen, vutrisiran,
  and 16 further inclisiran trials.

GRADING RULES APPLIED CONSISTENTLY ACROSS THE LANE (state these to the reviewer)
  1. Incidence AT OR BELOW the concurrent control arm = grade 0, always. 42 of 131 rows are grade 0. These are real
     negative controls, not padding, and several are the most informative rows in the set (see the inclisiran
     hydrocephalus row and the tominersen Q16W rows).
  2. Above control, non-serious, mild = grade 1. Above control and coded SERIOUS with an inflammatory/structural CNS
     character (myelitis, chemical or aseptic meningitis, radiculopathy, papilloedema, raised ICP) = grade 2.
     Hydrocephalus coded SERIOUS = grade 3.
  3. Serious radiculopathy = 2, non-serious radiculopathy = 1. Applied uniformly so the two are comparable.
  4. Single non-specific serious events (loss of consciousness, seizure, ataxia in Huntington's, hypoxic-ischaemic
     encephalopathy in infantile SMA) were graded 1, NOT 2, because a single event in a population whose underlying
     disease produces that same event cannot be attributed to the oligonucleotide from an AE table.

PROCEDURE-RELATED EVENTS - HOW THEY WERE HANDLED
  Post-lumbar-puncture syndrome, procedural headache, back pain and much of the plain headache burden are caused by the
  INTRATHECAL INJECTION PROCEDURE, not by the oligonucleotide. Every such row says so explicitly in notes. The evidence
  for that reading is inside the dataset: in VALOR the post-LP-syndrome rate is LOWER on tofersen than on intrathecal
  placebo (18.1% vs 30.6%) and headache is essentially identical (45.8% vs 44.4%); in WVE-120101 post-LP syndrome is
  0% at the top dose versus 12.5% on placebo; and in systemically dosed inclisiran, back pain is exactly equal to
  placebo (39/781 vs 39/778). Those rows are graded 0.

CONFOUND THAT MUST NOT BE MISSED - THE NUSINERSEN SHAM
  In ENDEAR (NCT02193074) and CHERISH (NCT02292537) the control was a SHAM PROCEDURE described in the record as a
  'small needle prick on the lower back at the location where the IT injection is normally made'. There was NO dural
  puncture in the control arm. The large headache (28.6% vs 7.1%) and back pain (25.0% vs 0%) excesses in CHERISH are
  therefore driven by the lumbar puncture itself and CANNOT be read as oligonucleotide toxicity. Those four rows are
  graded 1 with the confound stated. This is the single most important caveat in this lane: a naive reading of the
  CHERISH AE table would produce a spurious nusinersen neurotoxicity signal. Contrast with tofersen and tominersen,
  where the control arms received real intrathecal injections and the same terms show no excess.

STRONGEST GENUINE SIGNALS IN THIS LANE
  - Hydrocephalus, tominersen: 2/263 on every-8-week dosing versus 0/264 concurrent intrathecal placebo AND 0/264 on
    every-16-week dosing (NCT03761849), independently replicated as 1/23 monthly versus 0/23 bimonthly in the extension
    (NCT03342053), which also reports cerebral ventricle dilatation 2/23 monthly versus 0/23 bimonthly. A within-study,
    exposure-dependent hydrocephalus/ventriculomegaly signal - exactly the endpoint the NCATS brief names.
  - Raised intracranial pressure / papilloedema, tofersen: serious raised-ICP events in all three arms of the long-term
    extension (NCT03070119) plus papilloedema, under chronic intrathecal exposure.
  - Raised ICP and CSF pressure, nusinersen: dose-dependent (1/16 at 50/28 mg vs 0/8 at the approved 12 mg in DEVOTE
    later-onset SMA; 2/40 CSF pressure increased after a single 50 mg dose).
  - Myelitis and chemical/aseptic meningitis appear with BOTH tofersen and tominersen, suggesting an intrathecal
    phosphorothioate-ASO class effect rather than a target-specific one.
  - CSF protein and CSF white-cell rises are consistently above concurrent intrathecal placebo and scale with exposure
    (tofersen: 8.3% CSF protein at 24 weeks in VALOR vs 23.8% under chronic dosing in the extension).

KNOWN LIMITATIONS AND THINGS LEFT TBD - PLEASE RE-CHECK THESE
  - dose_or_conc_value is TBD/TBD for the 13 tominersen extension rows (NCT03342053): the AE arm titles give the dosing
    INTERVAL (monthly vs bimonthly) but the record's arm descriptions do not state the milligram dose, so it was not
    filled in. The parent study used 120 mg; that was NOT carried across because it was not read in that record.
  - Open-label extensions (NCT03070119, NCT03342053 partly, NCT04089566 Part C, NCT02386553) have NO placebo arm.
    Their effect_vs_control is either 'no_concurrent_control_arm' or a comparison against a lower-dose/lower-frequency
    ACTIVE arm or a different genotype group. Every such row states which in notes. Do not read these as placebo-controlled.
  - Golodirsen rows use an UNTREATED NATURAL-HISTORY group (not amenable to exon 53 skipping) as comparator - not
    randomised, not genotype-matched. The Part 1 placebo arm is n=4. Both caveats are in notes.
  - reversibility is 'not_assessed' on most rows: AE tables report incidence, not outcome or time to resolution.
    Where 'reversible' is recorded it reflects the self-limiting nature of the event class (post-LP headache), not a
    resolution statistic read from the record.
  - neurotox_grade 3 was assigned to the 2 serious-hydrocephalus rows on the basis of SERIOUS-adverse-event coding. The AE
    tables do NOT state whether shunting or other intervention was required, which is the rubric's actual grade-3
    criterion. Confirm from the publications or CSRs before publication; these may belong at grade 2.
  - Three grade-2 rows (transverse myelitis, demyelination, neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder) could each be
    grade 3 if they left a persisting deficit. No outcome data exists in an AE table. Flagged individually in notes.
  - oligo_class for viltolarsen, golodirsen, mipomersen and volanesorsen, and conjugate for patisiran and inclisiran,
    are ANNOTATIONS rather than values read from a fetched document. They are flagged 'VERIFY' in each oligo's notes.
    Only tofersen and nusinersen have chemistry read from an actual label this session; every other oligo's chemistry
    fields are TBD by design and should be merged from the regulatory/patent lanes.
  - AE tables use a frequency threshold (5% for most of these studies; 0% for NCT04089566 and NCT00607373). Terms below
    the threshold are simply absent from the record, so a 0 in a control arm can mean 'below threshold' rather than
    'genuinely zero'. This biases treated-vs-control ratios upward for rare terms and is the main reason single-event
    rows were graded conservatively.
  - ENDEAR (NCT02193074) reported NO nervous-system terms in otherEvents above its 5% threshold; only two serious
    CNS terms were available, so only two rows came from that study despite it being a large pivotal trial.

REDISTRIBUTION: all measurement rows are 'public_domain' - ClinicalTrials.gov posted results are US government data,
as are the two DailyMed labels used for the tofersen and nusinersen design fields.
